children: Cathie Wood-led Ark Investment Management made several portfolio adjustments on Friday, with the firm's latest trading disclosures showing activity across its flagship Ark Innovation ETF (ARKK), Ark Genomic Revolution ETF (ARKG) and Ark Autonomous Technology & Robotics ETF (ARKQ).
Ark’s trading activity on Friday covered a mix of technology, biotechnology and electric vehicle-related stocks.
Ark Loads Up On SPCX, CRSP, TEM
Ark's buying activity spanned a wider range of companies, with biotechnology names featuring prominently across its ARKK and ARKG ETFs.

Ark purchased Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SPCX) shares for two consecutive days, adding over 108,000 shares of the Elon Musk-led space giant to its kitty. ARKK purchased 70,601 SpaceX shares on Friday, doubling down on its purchase of 37,788 shares of the company on Wednesday.

Within ARKK, the fund added 35,772 shares of CRISPR Therapeutics AG (CRSP) and 115,086 shares of Recursion Pharmaceuticals Inc. (RXRX). It also purchased 10,114 shares of Tempus AI Inc. (TEM), adding to its exposure to the company.
The fund's other purchases included 24,873 shares of Twist Bioscience Corp. (TWST), 8,213 shares of Beam Therapeutics Inc. (BEAM) and 1,857 shares of Natera Inc. (NTRA).

Meanwhile, ARKG also added to its positions in biotechnology companies, purchasing 1,284 shares of Twist Bioscience Corp. (TWST) and 206 shares of Beam Therapeutics Inc. (BEAM). The fund additionally bought 6,538 shares of Arcturus Therapeutics Holdings Inc. (ARCT).
On the selling side, Ark's activity was concentrated in three stocks, with the bulk of the reductions coming from its flagship ARKK.

The fund sold 93,123 shares of Illumina Inc. (ILMN), representing 0.3419% of the ETF, according to the trading disclosure. It also offloaded 39,123 shares of Shopify Inc. (SHOP), equivalent to 0.1001% of ARKK.
The selling extended beyond ARKK, with the Ark Autonomous Technology & Robotics ETF (ARKQ) disposing of 296 shares of BYD Company Limited (BYDDY).
closed higher by more than 3% in Friday’s regular trading session. Retail sentiment on Stocktwits around ARKK trended in the ‘bearish’ territory at the time of writing.
